scenario.name: Salesforce JA3, FoxIO JA4+ & CISA DFIR — Zeek ssl.log JA3/JA4 Fingerprint & Malleable C2 Jitter Beaconing Forensics
scenario.overview: A covert courier disguises every sealed dispatch pouch to look like ordinary office mail, yet the unique way they knock at the gate, the blank default seal printed by their remote warehouse, and the rhythmic ticking of their hourly pickups expose the secret route to observant harbor inspectors. In this scenario (T1071.001, Salesforce JA3, FoxIO JA4+ & CISA DFIR, Zeek ssl.log JA3/JA4 Fingerprint & Malleable C2 Jitter Beaconing Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: tLS ClientHello Fingerprinting in Zeek, then serverHello JA3S Correlation, then periodic Sleep/Jitter Statistical Histogram. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering TLS ClientHello Fingerprinting in Zeek, then ServerHello JA3S Correlation, then Periodic Sleep/Jitter Statistical Histogram, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates Sysmon Event 3 with the documented host and network chain.
